paragraphs: In Pesachim 57a, Abba Shaul ben Batnit said in the name of Abba Yosef ben Chanin: “Woe to me because of the house of Kartos; woe to me because of their pens.” They said there that they were high priests and all their attendants were wicked.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading has Kathros (קתרוס), while the body has Kartos (קרתוס). Both forms are preserved.

The checked Pesachim 57a passage has Kathros, matching the heading, beside Kartos in Hyman’s body. It gives Abba Shaul ben Batnit reporting Abba Yosef ben Chanin, refers to pens, and describes high priests, their sons and sons-in-law, and servants who beat people. Hyman’s statement about wicked attendants is an abridged account, not a complete quotation of that list.
